title: The √13 wall forces the lattice to close and cuts off the ultraviolet

statements.text: Because $\sqrt{13} \notin K$, the lattice over $K$ cannot contain vectors whose lengths need the primes 7, 11 or 13. The capacity paper states this as a theorem: the cascade terminates at the Kummer wall, which forces the tiling to close, makes the fibre $T^3$ compact and resolves the ultraviolet catastrophe.

sources.quote: This forces the tiling to close, providing the strict algebraic mechanism for why the fibre $T^3$ must be compact.
